ranking_backend.cross_arm_comparability: Compare AP across wrappers only on matched known cohorts; wrapper UNKNOWN can exclude an otherwise known component score
ranking_backend.modeled_backend_note: Small authored backend diagnostic, not observed FinBot harm, not live prevention; null effect remains unknown

120 dependent pairs, not 240 independent trials; seeds reuse the same cases
Archive is posthoc development; raw64 previously disclosed
4B unavailable at deadline; prior-schema 4B is indirect evidence only
Sequence requires genuine observed checkpoints; raw sequence absence is structural UNSUPPORTED, not runtime UNKNOWN
Input admission amendments occurred before quality/labels; ML models frozen before external predictions; labels after all prediction seals
ExtensionRules checks only six clauses; UNKNOWN STOP included; not full old-policy guard
No paid API; costs must include complete source extraction, not only final ML head
No new confidence interval or low-FPR certification; high-value and real USD/FX branches untested
